module origen_005460(
    input [1:0] a,
    output reg [1:0] z
);
    always @(*) begin
        case(a)
            2'b00: z = 2'd2;
            2'b01: z = 2'd1;
            default: z = 2'd0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module clz4(
    input [3:0] a,
    output [5:0] z
);
    wire [1:0] upper, lower;
    
    clz2 upper_clz(.a(a[3:2]), .z(upper));
    clz2 lower_clz(.a(a[1:0]), .z(lower));
    
    assign z = (upper == 2'd2) ? {4'b0, upper + lower} : {4'b0, upper};
endmodule
